name: Ar’tor’s final charge

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Ar’tor directs the seeker toward Veneratus and the second fragment, lending a part of his spirit to the task. When the fragment is recovered, his spirit fades. The quest gives no reunion beyond that moment. The piece passes to the living, but Ar’tor’s own path ends there, preserving the cost at the heart of this branch rather than turning his help into a resurrection.
